verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page offers keeping an organization's data out of AI model training, but only for Enterprise organizations and only by contacting an account manager, not through a self-serve setting. A community report that recordings are used, anonymized, as training data under the privacy statement describes the default behavior and does not contradict the enterprise opt-out. Missing for 10: self-serve user-level opt-out control, availability outside Enterprise, detailed documentation of opt-out scope, independent corroboration that the opt-out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Keep your organization's data out of AI model training. Contact your account manager to get started.
